name: How long does it take to repair a damaged deck?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to repair a damaged deck?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time required for deck repair varies based on the size of the deck and the severity of the damage. Minor repairs, such as replacing a few boards, might take a day or two. More extensive repairs involving structural elements, multiple components, or a larger deck can take several days to a week or more. We'll provide a more accurate timeline after our initial assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time depends on deck size and damage severity, ranging from a day for minor fixes to a week or more for extensive repairs.
